items.text: Ahoy, Sailors!

We’re thrilled to announce that Update v0.8 is officially live! This major update brings new features, improved systems, and enhanced performance, including Tier 3 ships, a revamped cargo and mission system, and more. While the update is still a work in progress, we're committed to refining and expanding the game in the upcoming patches. Stay tuned for more exciting updates!
Check out the new trailer for a sneak peek at what’s on the horizon for - Ships At Sea!

Ahoy all fishermen,

A new major update version: 1.7.901.10367 is now ready for download. We have been working really hard the past months with this major update that comes with several new features, two new boats, several improvements and fixes.

Fishing: North Atlantic now supports ray tracing. To enable this graphical feature you need to enable DirectX 12. This is done via Options -> Video. Select DirectX 12, then restart the game. You will now be able to adjust the Ray Tracing to your likings.
Note: Be aware that this feature is very demanding on performance!
We added two new free boats, one is the legendary Andrea Gail that sank north-east of Sable Island on October 28, 1991. Our second boat is Mostein, from our new licensepartner Breeze.
Andrea Gail is a deepline boat and can be found at the docks in Lunenburg.
Mostein is a small pelagic trawler and is found at the docks in Lockeport.

We adjusted the game options to be connected to each savegame instead of global. If you see that your fast travel is not working, please check Options->Game from Main Menu and confirm that these options are enabled.
Note: Be aware that you might need to enable certain game options again on older savegames!
There is a new weather system in place, with volumetric clouds, lightning, new rain and snow particles. We also improved the waves.
We added a new custom start option, which has been highly requested by many players. You are now able to choose starter boats, date, adjust habitat size and fish prices.
Note: 100 is default for both selections. You can have the habitat size and fish prices 50% less or higher. This feature only works when you create a new game!

We are proud to announce that we now have two new licensepartners onboard. First is Breeze Ship Design, which are specialists in naval architecture and has a reference to over 4000 built vessels worldwide.
Second is NorSap, which are the leading manufacturer of high-quality chairs to the maritime and offshore industry.
Mostein is a boat designed by Breeze and you find NorSap's 1600 chair in Mostein as well.

Another feature that has been highly requested is the possibilty to control the trawldoors when you have your Scanmar system in fullscreen. From now you can control the trawldoors from the fullscreen Scanmar screen.
We added a new control sensor, where you use your mouse button/controller to click on the arrow up/down or locked position to control the trawldoors without closing the Scanmar screen.
We also added crew training. Now you can pay if you want to skill up your crew in ports.

If you experience problems with your Steering wheel, please rename or delete the folder WindowsNoEditor under C:\Users\\AppData\Local\FNA\Saved\Config and then reconfigure the wheel again, this should fix your issue. Also check here if you need more details for how to set it up.
Known Issue
If you experience flickering clouds, you can adjust this with the Sky Quality setting under Options -> Video and set it to Epic or Low. We hope to have a fix for this very shortly!

Ahoy all fishermen,
A new update version: 1.6.837.9446 is now ready for download. This is a major update with new features, several improvements and fixes.
A new start option has been added, you can now select between Easy or Hard mode when starting a new game.
Easy mode, you will start with the fast No Yankee rigged for lobster fishing at 1st of April in the season, everything else will be as before.
Hard mode, you will start with Mikki rigged for harpooning at 1st of August, fish habitats and prices are reduced by 30%.
NOTE: You need to start a new game to use these features. Previous savegames will be set to Easy!
We added a new steel wire lobster pot, this gives you 30% better yield than wooden pots. We also increased the yield on both wooden and steel pots. Snow crab pots have also got increased yield.

We are happy to announce a new licensepartner ProNav. ProNav delivers products for navigation, communication and security to commercial vessels. You can get their radar as an upgrade for all the bigger boats in the game.
A new bait have been added to target Silver Hake with longlines.
We added a indicator in the HUD, when the autopilot are enabled.
A reworked habitat system is also in place, making fish availability better over time. You can now see the health status of all the habitats available on the map in your logbook.

We added a new Habitat Extinction option, when enabled you will need to be more careful with fishing to much on each habitat, to much and its wiped out. Give habitats time to recover to keep them sustainable over time. Without this option enabled, habitat healths will never go below 25%.
Scallop habitats are now found around the map instead of everywhere. Each port will have a dedicated scallop habitat, just ask for some tips for location at the bar in ports.

NOTE: If you experience low habitat messages, please check your Logbook -> Habitats to see the health of the habitat you are fishing on. The number above the fishtip is the habitat number you see in your logbook.
We balanced the supply and demand for each port, this will help to reduce huge price drops and keep it more consistent over time, even when selling huge loads of fish.
You will now be able to catch mackerel using nets.
You are now able to trawl on depths at 100m instead of 200m.

Hi all fishermen!
A new update 1.1.386.4940 is now available on the main branch.
In this update we have upgraded to a new Unreal Engine version, which should give several improvements on performance and stability.

We have also reworked the fish seasons, so you will no longer get fish species when out of their season, this will prevent filling your gears with fish you are not allowed to catch. Hopefully, this will feel better than the previous way, where you lost your catch out of the season. There are also some adjustments on season length for Snow Crab and Tuna + prices on several species.
Now you also find a new dedicated crew slot for preparing bait, which should solve most of the issues with setting both snow crab and lobster pots.
